change: Non-destructive first-run personal progress initialization and Windows launcher integration

validation.command: python -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s learning/tests -p test_bootstrap.py -v
validation.environment: Windows; all initialization and API state created in validated disposable scratch copies under paths containing spaces and Chinese characters
passedCases: Corrupt existing progress is rejected without changing its bytes or modification time
Existing personal revision, interface preference, decisions, notes, and learner completions remain byte-identical and keep their modification time
A fresh initialized checkout starts the local server and serves the same state through GET /api/bootstrap
Fresh initialization and manage status work in a relocated path containing spaces and Chinese characters
An independently held real OS progress lock prevents initialization and partial state creation
The Python initialize API returns (created, progress) for both the new and preserved-state cases
Malformed, duplicated, escaping, and empty catalog definitions fail before workspace or progress creation
An actual Windows directory junction is rejected without writing into its target
A file obstructing a later workspace prevents creation of the earlier workspaces and progress

skippedCases.case: Dangling progress symlink is never replaced
skippedCases.reason: The current Windows account cannot create file symlinks

skippedCases.case: Workspace directory symlink is rejected without writing into its target
skippedCases.reason: The current Windows account cannot create directory symlinks

validation.launcherSyntax: PowerShell Parser.ParseFile returned no syntax errors

protectedProgress.note: The test suite itself does not read or use the author's private progress as a fixture. Only before/after hashes were compared outside the tests.

limits: This validation concerns the new bootstrap and its isolated tests, not the eventual complete public Git checkout.
No live learner completion, model, source evidence, manage.py, server.py, README, or Git metadata was changed by this subtask.
The launcher was syntax checked; it was not used to replace the currently running teaching service.
Linux execution, native Blender UI execution, and hosted GitHub Actions remain for separate verification.
